CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.
   B. Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Temptations of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Temptations of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
   D. Use The Temptations of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Leisure? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Leisure has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Leisure to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Jesus Christ.
   B. Use Miracles of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Miracles of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of Jacob Wrestles an Angel? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jacob Wrestles an Angel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jacob Wrestles an Angel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jacob Wrestles an Angel.
   D. Say Jacob Wrestles an Angel has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Call of Disciples? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Call of Disciples to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Call of Disciples.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Call of Disciples with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Call of Disciples has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
   B. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

12. Which response best shows understanding of Marriage and Family? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Marriage and Family.
   B. Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Marriage and Family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Marriage and Family has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship Formation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Sanctity of Life 4 5.4 Alcohol, drug and Substance Abuse 4 Total Number of Lesso and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Sanctity of Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
